name: Mantis-Eval
intro: Mantis-Eval 是 Mantis 论文发布的留出多图理解测试集，由标注者使用 Google 搜索获取图像并人工编写必须联合理解多张图像的问题。它包含 217 条英文样本，平均每条 2.5 张图、最多 5 张图，同时覆盖多选题和简答题。
build_method: Google图像检索, 人工多图问题编写与整理
metric: 多选准确率, 简答准确率, 总体准确率
task_type: 多图像理解, 视觉问答
eval_feature: 跨图推理, 共指理解
scale: 217条测试样本（200道多选题、17道简答题）；平均2.5张图，最多5张图
build_method_en: Google image search, manual multi-image question authoring and curation
intro_en: Mantis-Eval is the held-out multi-image understanding test set introduced by the Mantis paper. Annotators acquire images through Google Search and manually author questions that require joint understanding of multiple images. Its 217 English examples contain 2.5 images on average and at most five, with both multiple-choice and short-answer formats.

drawio_review_note: Evidence pinned to arXiv:2405.01483v3, Mantis commit f3a319202d882a1794d28440b77bba7c58869a9e, evaluator commits 44d20bf6d3c0a3f4e3da040829a2d234c67c79a0 and 33561424de2e03b46382bbdbad977af752c32954, and Hugging Face snapshot a3d92f9eb22c31d8c2d9d5b432c5a0ff1ef6dfd5. The paper discloses annotator acquisition through Google Search and manual authoring of questions requiring joint understanding across images, with 217 held-out English examples, a 2.5-image average and five-image maximum. Candidate counts, rejection rules, QC review or adjudication, and MCQ option or distractor generation are not disclosed and are deliberately not invented; the snapshot's broader data_source labels are shown as a paper-to-release boundary. Evaluation follows the official code. When support_multi_image is true, the controller preserves image-text interleaving and adds missing placeholders. When false, it removes placeholders and passes every image before the joined text; the selected wrapper then decides how to consume those images. QwenVL preserves the image list through from_list_format, while several single-image wrappers call merge_images, which rescales images to their average height and joins them horizontally with 10-pixel separators. The evaluator then branches by question type and applies the three answer-marker rules; for multiple choice it compares a valid first alphabetic letter, otherwise falling back to case-sensitive exact raw-response versus normalized gold-option text; for short answer it compares case-insensitively after reference normalization and marker-suffix trimming, while an unmarked response remains raw. All rows remain in the denominator: 200 multiple-choice, 17 short-answer and 217 overall. Generation settings remain wrapper-specific, and per-image third-party licensing is not mapped by the release. Formal publication evidence [site-a11q-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 4285×777 (English) and 4285×777 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 4283×775 and 4283×775. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
